projects.description: Car‑wash booking platform with slot‑based scheduling, online payment, and tier‑based loyalty program. Implemented authentication, booking, payment, notification, membership, review, wash session, and reward exchange modules. Built 50+ RESTful APIs and designed over 20 MySQL tables. Added slot‑conflict detection, deposit handling, three user roles (Customer/Staff/Admin), and a loyalty module with point calculation, 6‑month expiry, and scheduled tier review. Integrated VNPAY payment gateway with IPN webhook verification and automatic reconciliation. Secured endpoints with Spring Security JWT and RBAC across ~50 endpoints.
